To all,
As of today I wanted update you all with an important milestone for the XYZ Product Launch Initiative. 

Our product testing with a focus sample set concluded successfully and we've received valuable qualitative/ quantitative insights into the features. Based largely off those learnins our product has evolved and improved greatly in user experience as compared  to last week. 

Moving ahead we need all departments, but a key focus being Marketing/ Customer Service - to be available in 4 business-days from when your received a test kit (we are mailing kits this week and expect to mail all out next Monday, Nov.3rd). 

A practical challenge we have faced so is the volume/pace. Our testing team received many test back and they have all gone out. The team can process about one a month and that won’t scale for the incoming test results as we scale the initiative out. This is important because as we roll into a wider launch we can't risk any of the incoming tests not going into queue to get analyzed in the order that came to us.

Thanks in advance, and looking towards next week’s launch
